source_data_policy: Raw video, decoded frames, ROI patches and texture images remain local under ignored out/; only hashes and aggregate diagnostics are committed.

method.alignment: per-ROI integer phase correlation to center frame
method.reproducibility: Two independent three-frame builds matched decoded-frame, median-patch, direct-texture and quilt hashes for both ROIs.
method.unit_tests: 6 texture tests passed, including integer-shift recovery, max-shift rejection, and reviewed UV-layer rebinding.
method.primary_texture: single aligned temporal-median crop resampled to UV texture; no tiling

static_usd_candidate.operation: Reused the provenance-checked UV/material layer and replaced only the two RGB texture asset paths.

observed: The direct crop preserves real tissue color but becomes visibly soft when stretched across a 1024x1024 UV image.
A residual bright highlight remains in the appendix crop.
Quilted alternative still creates repeated tissue forms and is not promoted.
The short temporal median lowers a narrow highlight statistic while reducing local image gradients; these are diagnostics, not realism metrics.
visual_review.promotion: Do not use as the accepted simulator appearance until a moving-endoscope render and blinded real-video comparison pass.

interpretation: Three nearby frames support a reproducible local color candidate, not a stable surface reconstruction.
The available ROI does not provide calibrated camera pose, depth, a same-patient CT-to-video map, or nonrigid surface correspondence.
Video RGB still mixes tissue reflectance with endoscope lighting, white balance, and specular response.
next_gate: Select or segment verified appendix and mesoappendix tissue across more cases.
Estimate and report camera-relative motion and glint uncertainty without treating phase correlation as nonrigid tracking.
Apply candidates to dynamic mesh UVs and compare rendered sequences under a moving endoscope.
Keep the appearance gate false until held-out and blinded visual review is complete.
